title: Anthropic Signs $35 Billion Cloud Agreement With Nvidia-Backed Lambda in Deal Where Chip Giant Holds the Lease: Report
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Nvidia 支持的 Lambda 签署价值 350 亿美元的云协议，芯片巨头持有租赁权：报告
summary: Anthropic has reportedly signed a $35 billion cloud-computing agreement with Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA)-backed Lambda, with the latter itself holding the lease for the Texas data center that will support the deal.
summary_zh: 据报道，Anthropic 已与 Nvidia 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）支持的 Lambda 签署了一项价值 350 亿美元的云计算协议，后者本身持有德克萨斯州数据中心的租约，这将支持该交易。

title: Marvell's Hyperscaler Deal Lands In A Fiscal Year Management Will Not Size Yet
title_zh: Marvell 的超大规模交易在本财年达成 管理层尚未确定规模
summary: The programs the deal covers in the near term were already inside the targets management had published, and it is connectivity rather than custom silicon that management points to for the raise that did arrive.
summary_zh: 该交易涵盖的近期计划已经在管理层公布的目标之内，管理层指出，真正实现的加薪是连接性而非定制芯片。

title: Fresh Off a U.S. Funding Deal, This Quantum Start-Up Is Moving Into Data Centers
title_zh: 这家刚刚完成美国融资协议的量子初创企业正在进军数据中心
summary: Diraq is deploying a quantum computer directly into a commercial data center, marking a real-world example of hybrid computing.
summary_zh: Diraq 正在将量子计算机直接部署到商业数据中心，这是混合计算的现实示例。

title: SLB Wants In on the AI Data Center Boom. This $4B Deal Could Help.
title_zh: SLB 希望参与人工智能数据中心的繁荣。这笔 4B 美元的交易可能会有所帮助。
summary: Public backlash against artificial intelligence data centers is real, but investors still like it when companies gain a toehold in the booming business.
summary_zh: 公众对人工智能数据中心的强烈反对是真实存在的，但投资者仍然喜欢公司在蓬勃发展的业务中站稳脚跟。

title: Apollo to Repackage $9 Billion Oneok Stake Into Debt Deal
title_zh: Apollo 将 90 亿美元 Oneok 股份重新打包成债务交易
summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. is looking to turn another multibillion-dollar corporate equity deal into investment-grade debt it can sell to investors.
summary_zh: 阿波罗全球管理公司(Apollo Global Management Inc.)正寻求将另一笔价值数十亿美元的企业股权交易转化为可出售给投资者的投资级债务。
